description: Research software accompanying the manuscript 'hygel_builder: Auditable Graph-First Construction of Prescribed Periodic Coarse-Grained Hydrogel Networks'. Includes the explicit-plan periodic graph planner, endpoint materialization, pre-router plan record, router-independent topology audits, and the template interaction contract.
notes: This work was supported by the National Research Foundation of Korea (NRF) grant funded by the Korea government (MSIT) (RS-2025-25424498). Parts of the code, tests, and documentation were drafted or revised with the assistance of AI coding assistants (OpenAI Codex and Anthropic Claude). All changes were reviewed by the authors, who take responsibility for the software.
